name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.6 degrees south of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 6 visits over 41 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 27 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 41 hours starting 2026-03-28, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.72 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
